thread:
mika: quick follow-up from the compact-headers RFC  proposing gateway emit a tiny billing ledger row for billing routes to avoid late-attr joins and heavy backfills

omar: SGTM. ledger row shape?

mika: `{ trace_id, billing_key, customer_id, route_id, ts, sig }`  ~120 bytes. append-only stream optimized for rollups.

lena: How do we handle retries/dedupe?

omar: dedupe on trace_id + ledger_version. sig = HMAC(route_token || trace_id || ts) so consumers can verify authenticity. gateway bumps ledger_version on retry.

lena: Ops asks: surface `ledger_pending_count`, `gateway_billing_cache_hit_rate`, `ledger_dedup_rate`. Alert if pending_count > 2k for 5m.

mika: plan: gateway keeps a small cache for billing_key (ttl ~10s). For billing routes we do sync lookup (adds ~5-15ms). Non-billing routes emit `_pending` ledger row and async enrich/backfill.

ryan: rollout suggestion: 2% canary (48h) -> synthetic parity job comparing ledger sums to baseline -> if delta < 0.1% ramp.

ingest-bot: deploy status: ledger-writer -> green :white_check_mark:

mika: thanks all. I'll open PR + runbook and follow up in #product. Closing when canary passes.
